description: Shared PDF comment entry used by both annotation panels: a TmAvatar with initials or the author's image, the body with an edited marker, and a "..." TmDropdown menu with Edit and Delete in place of an inline link. Editing is an inline textarea with Save/Cancel, Ctrl+Enter and Escape.

parameters.name: ThreadId
parameters.description: Thread that owns the comment; used for edit/delete requests.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id, used with DocumentCommentPermissionHelper.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether panel interaction is disabled; hides the action menu.

parameters.name: OnEditRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the edited body is saved.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the comment is deleted.

parameters.name: TestIdBase
parameters.description: Base of the panel's testid contract (e.g. pdf-annotation or pdf-annotator); internal test ids are derived as {base}-comment, {base}-edit, {base}-delete, {base}-edit-input, {base}-edit-save and {base}-edit-cancel.
